This page demonstrates the clinical utility of ALIGATEHR-Gen through a focused case study on seven fibrotic diseases: CKD, Cardiac Fibrosis, MASH, Pulmonary Fibrosis, SSc/Connective Tissue, Crohn's Disease, and Fibrosis of Skin.

## Patient Embeddings — 7 Fibrotic Diseases {#fibrotic-embedding}

The plot below loads its display-safe reference points from the same backend Dataset Release used by preset and confirmed Demo Profile walkthroughs. It contains no source participant IDs or individual clinical profiles.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { createEmbeddingScatter } from "./embedding-scatter.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

createFibroticScatterplot = (await import("https://esm.sh/regl-scatterplot@1.9.1")).default
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

fibroticWalkthrough = {
  const host = document.createElement("div");
  host.className = "embedding-loader";
  host.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  let removeRequestListener = () => {};
  const colors = [
    "#4477aa", "#ee7733", "#228833", "#cc3311",
    "#aa3377", "#66ccee", "#bbbb44"
  ];
  const names = {
    CKD: "Chronic Kidney Disease",
    Cardiac_Fibrosis: "Cardiac Fibrosis",
    MASH: "MASH",
    Pulmonary_fibrosis: "Pulmonary Fibrosis",
    SSc_Connective_Tissue: "Systemic Sclerosis / Connective Tissue",
    Crohns_Disease: "Crohn's Disease",
    Fibrosis_of_Skin: "Skin Fibrosis",
    pure: "Pure display group",
    intermediate: "Intermediate display group",
    overlap: "Overlap display group",
  };
  const displayName = value => names[value] || String(value).replace(/_/g, " ");

  function loading() {
    host.innerHTML =
      '<div class="embedding-load-state"><div class="embedding-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></div>' +
      '<strong>Loading the current fibrotic Dataset Release…</strong>' +
      '<span>Hugging Face may need a moment to wake from a cold start.</span></div>';
  }

  function failure(message) {
    host.innerHTML = "";
    const state = document.createElement("div");
    state.className = "embedding-load-state embedding-load-error";
    const title = document.createElement("strong");
    title.textContent = "The fibrotic embedding is temporarily unavailable.";
    const detail = document.createElement("span");
    detail.textContent = message;
    const retry = document.createElement("button");
    retry.type = "button";
    retry.className = "embedding-button embedding-button-primary";
    retry.textContent = "Retry";
    retry.addEventListener("click", load);
    state.append(title, detail, retry);
    host.appendChild(state);
  }

  async function requestHelper() {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt += 1) {
      if (window.ALIGATEHR_EMBEDDING_DEMO) return window.ALIGATEHR_EMBEDDING_DEMO;
      await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function load() {
    loading();
    try {
      const helper = await requestHelper();
      if (!helper) throw new Error("The visualization request helper is unavailable.");
      const apiUrl = helper.resolveApiUrl(window.location, window.ALIGATEHR_API_URL);
      const [embeddingResponse, presetResponse] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(apiUrl + "/embedding/fibrotic", { cache: "no-store" }),
        fetch(apiUrl + "/embedding/fibrotic/preset", { cache: "no-store" }),
      ]);
      if (!embeddingResponse.ok || !presetResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error("Backend returned an unavailable response. No local patient-data fallback was used.");
      }
      const embedding = await embeddingResponse.json();
      const preset = await presetResponse.json();
      if (embedding.dataset_version !== preset.dataset_version) {
        throw new Error("Dataset versions differ. Refresh after the backend release finishes updating.");
      }

      const consumed = helper.consumeRequest(sessionStorage, embedding.dataset_version);
      if (consumed.status === "version_mismatch") {
        throw new Error("The saved walkthrough belongs to an older Dataset Release. Start the demo again from the chatbot.");
      }

      const chart = await createEmbeddingScatter({
        data: embedding.points,
        datasetVersion: embedding.dataset_version,
        createScatterplot: createFibroticScatterplot,
        colors,
        displayName,
        preset,
        request: consumed.request,
        autoplay: consumed.should_play,
      });
      host.replaceChildren(chart);
      removeRequestListener();
      removeRequestListener = helper.connectRequestConsumer(
        window,
        sessionStorage,
        embedding.dataset_version,
        request => chart.embeddingWalkthrough.play(request),
      );
      invalidation.then(() => removeRequestListener());
      window.__ALIGATEHR_FIBROTIC_READY__ = true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Fibrotic embedding load error:", error);
      failure(error.message || "Please retry when the backend is available.");
    }
  }

  load();
  return host;
}
```

## Top Risk Factors by Disease

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

featureData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/feature_importance.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

fibroticDiseaseList = [...new Set(featureData.map(d => d.disease))]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof featureDisease = Inputs.select(fibroticDiseaseList, { label: "Disease", value: fibroticDiseaseList[0] })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

featureChart = {
  const filtered = featureData
    .filter(d => d.disease === featureDisease && d.rank <= 15)
    .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 420,
    marginLeft: 220,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: "Importance Score", grid: true },
    y: { label: null, domain: filtered.map(d => d.feature) },
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(filtered, {
        x: "importance_score",
        y: "feature",
        fill: "#2c5aa0",
      }),
    ],
  });

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.position = "relative";
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Top Risk Factors — ${featureDisease}</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">Top 15 features by global importance score</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  const tooltip = document.createElement("div");
  tooltip.className = "chart-tooltip";
  tooltip.style.cssText = "position:fixed;display:none;pointer-events:none;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.85rem;line-height:1.4;z-index:1000;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);color:#fff;max-width:280px;white-space:nowrap;";
  container.appendChild(tooltip);

  const rects = chart.querySelectorAll("rect");
  rects.forEach((rect, i) => {
    rect.style.transition = "opacity 150ms ease";
    rect.addEventListener("mouseenter", (e) => {
      rects.forEach((r, j) => { r.style.opacity = j === i ? "1" : "0.2"; });
      const d = filtered[i];
      if (d) {
        tooltip.innerHTML = `<strong>${d.feature}</strong><br>Importance: ${d.importance_score.toFixed(4)}<br>Rank: #${d.rank}<br>Disease: ${d.disease}`;
        tooltip.style.display = "block";
      }
    });
    rect.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
      const x = Math.min(e.clientX + 12, window.innerWidth - tooltip.offsetWidth - 8);
      const y = Math.min(e.clientY + 12, window.innerHeight - tooltip.offsetHeight - 8);
      tooltip.style.left = x + "px";
      tooltip.style.top = y + "px";
    });
    rect.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      rects.forEach(r => { r.style.opacity = "1"; });
      tooltip.style.display = "none";
    });
  });

  return container;
}
```

## Pathway Enrichment Analysis

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

pathwayData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/pathway_enrichment.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof pathwayDisease = Inputs.select(fibroticDiseaseList, { label: "Disease", value: fibroticDiseaseList[0] })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

pathwayChart = {
  const filtered = pathwayData
    .filter(d => d.disease === pathwayDisease && d.rank <= 15)
    .sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);

  const withLogP = filtered.map(d => ({
    ...d,
    neg_log10_padj: -Math.log10(d.p_adjusted),
  }));

  const minER = d3.min(withLogP, d => d.enrichment_ratio);
  const maxER = d3.max(withLogP, d => d.enrichment_ratio);
  const xPad = (maxER - minER) * 0.12;

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 480,
    marginLeft: 280,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: "Enrichment Ratio", grid: true, domain: [minER - xPad, maxER + xPad * 0.3] },
    y: {
      label: null,
      domain: withLogP.map(d => d.pathway),
    },
    r: { range: [4, 16], label: "Gene Count" },
    color: { scheme: "YlOrRd", label: "-log₁₀(p adjusted)", legend: true },
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(withLogP, {
        x: "enrichment_ratio",
        y: "pathway",
        r: "gene_count",
        fill: "neg_log10_padj",
        stroke: "#dee2e6",
        strokeWidth: 0.5,
      }),
    ],
  });

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.position = "relative";
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Pathway Enrichment — ${pathwayDisease}</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">Top 15 pathways by significance · Dot size = gene count · Color = -log₁₀(adj. p-value)</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  const tooltip = document.createElement("div");
  tooltip.className = "chart-tooltip";
  tooltip.style.cssText = "position:fixed;display:none;pointer-events:none;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.85rem;line-height:1.4;z-index:1000;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);color:#fff;max-width:320px;white-space:nowrap;";
  container.appendChild(tooltip);

  const circles = chart.querySelectorAll("circle");
  circles.forEach((circle, i) => {
    circle.style.transition = "opacity 150ms ease";
    circle.addEventListener("mouseenter", (e) => {
      circles.forEach((c, j) => { c.style.opacity = j === i ? "1" : "0.2"; });
      const d = withLogP[i];
      if (d) {
        tooltip.innerHTML = `<strong>${d.pathway}</strong><br>Source: ${d.source}<br>Gene Count: ${d.gene_count}<br>Enrichment Ratio: ${d.enrichment_ratio.toFixed(2)}<br>P-value: ${Number(d.p_value).toExponential(2)}<br>Adj. P-value: ${Number(d.p_adjusted).toExponential(2)}`;
        tooltip.style.display = "block";
      }
    });
    circle.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
      const x = Math.min(e.clientX + 12, window.innerWidth - tooltip.offsetWidth - 8);
      const y = Math.min(e.clientY + 12, window.innerHeight - tooltip.offsetHeight - 8);
      tooltip.style.left = x + "px";
      tooltip.style.top = y + "px";
    });
    circle.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      circles.forEach(c => { c.style.opacity = "1"; });
      tooltip.style.display = "none";
    });
  });

  return container;
}
```
